scripts.dev: npm run build && python3 -m http.server --directory public 8787
scripts.dev:cloudflare: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4.91.0 dev
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4.91.0 deploy
scripts.deploy:cloudflare:staging: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4.91.0 deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:netlify: npm run build && npx --yes --ignore-scripts netlify-cli@27.5.0 deploy --prod --dir=public
scripts.deploy:netlify:staging: npm run build && npx --yes --ignore-scripts netlify-cli@27.5.0 deploy --dir=public
